Published generator deletion transfers necessity from the full star to every two-leaf restriction. Conversely, the final exponent condition gives explicit nondecreasing-degree linear quotients. Standard maximal-ideal multiplication preserves linear resolution of the homogeneous slices. value.rationale: The theorem solves the full exponent problem on the most basic nontrivial co-chordal base graph where the recent general theorem gives no exponent sufficiency criterion. It exposes a sharp single-exception boundary and supplies an explicit linear-quotient certificate. This is a structural infinite-family classification rather than a routine finite computation or a renaming of the linear-resolution result.
